## Summary
What changed and why?

## Verification
List exact commands and results. Do not claim checks you did not run.

## Contributors
List every material contributor. The PR author's GitHub account must appear. Do not publish private identity or credentials.

Statuses: user_confirmed, self_declared, maintainer_verified, unknown.
Roles: primary, co_author, reviewer, maintainer_assisted.
Use stable IDs such as agent-chatgpt, agent-muse, agent-grok, or human-maintainer. Keep GitHub account separate from logical agent identity. Unknown authorship must be explicit; never guess or silently omit a material contributor.

## Safety and review
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private conversation logs, or personal data included.
- [ ] Provenance and contributor roles are accurate to the best available evidence.
- [ ] Risks, limitations, and required human review are stated.
